description: Help Wanted (Yes, Really) This campaign runs on a candidate, his wife, a campaign manager, and a handful of people who know more than he does about their own subjects. Nobody is paid, including him. We're not taking donations — but that doesn't mean we can't use help. Volunteer labor doesn't count as a campaign
paid_for_by: Paid for by Michael Dorland, out of his own pocket, which is why the site has a weird mixture of pictures on it
title: Help Wanted - Dorland for Congress — Arizona's 6th District
